Name: Buford
Dialog: It doesn't hafta be chowder. Could be a bisque, broth, a consommé.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But wouldn't we get all covered in—

Name: Buford
Dialog: We'd all be delicious!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Covered in soup.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm just workshoppin' this okay? (Takes out a figurine of Phineas wearing a tuxedo.) Here, for scale. (Drops the figurine into the soup.) Bread Bowl Hot Tub.

Name: The gang
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gang, I know what we're gonna—

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, Blimey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, no.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why is he wearing a tuxedo? It looks like he should be on a wedding cake.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's mine! (takes the figurine) Don't you worry your little head about it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, my favorite bookcase finally gave up the ghost. A lot of these I should get rid of, but some of them are my favorites.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we can help. We could build you the ultimate bookcase.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! That's something we've never built before.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. Because it's boring. Whereas a Bread Bowl Hot Tub, on the other hand...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's gonna be the bookcase, isn't it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, it is!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Jolly good. We're gonna need wood and nails and—Oh, where's Perry?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Why would we need Perry to build the bookcase?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I, uh, was just wondering.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, Agent P beat your high score!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, man.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've noticed an excess of plant life on Doof's balcony. We suspect it's part of a nefarious scheme. Get to the bottom of it, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm going back in, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can't keep chasing that high, Carl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, let me just fetch my spanner. I won't be a tick.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's a spanner?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: A wrench, (affecting the King's English) with an English accent.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And what's a tick?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: A parasitic arachnid that attaches itself to larger, warm-blooded vertebrates?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dis has not made anything clearer to me.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What did I come in here for again? Was it my Bench Warmer baseball cards, or this photo of me kicking an orange, or my sculpture of the world's happiest jackalope?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why are we building this thing again? Pretty sure the prevailing wisdom is reading is boring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Reading helps with your imagination.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. I'm out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Ferb, let's kick it off!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna give Dad the ultimate summer reading bookcase!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We can add rope swings, secret passages.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A homework checking station. I mean a foosball station.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (coming back in) And a pool! That's hot! Filled with soup! I'm back in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You want to come to the backyard with me, Mom... You want to come to the backyard...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You don't need me to see anything today. Dad's recruited the kids to help him build a bookshelf.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (drops watch) Hmmm, perhaps it's time to try a more psychological approach.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's really not.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehehehehehehehehehehehe... (cackles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (with a bandage around his head) Ah, Perry the Platypus. So glad you could "gum" by! I mean, I knew gumbody would visit, but it's gum. It's gum. You're in a gum trap. No, really. Don't. Don't break out so fast. I-I-I-I put way too much effort into that trap. Took me six days to chew all that gum.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I know it's gross, and my jaw is killing me. Anyway, behold my Face-Plant-inator! It doesn't make people fall on their faces. It makes plants with my face! My face on a plant!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'm aware that I look like someone's grandma, but I've taken up gardening because it was supposed to be relaxing. But instead, it brought up a lot of long-buried memories.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) In Gimmelshtump, the other kids used to tease me for not practicing photosynthesis.

Name: Drusselstinian kids
Dialog: Heinz has no chlorophyll! Heinz has no chloro...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that's a weird thing to tease someone about because who practices photosynthesis? It's literally just plants. But I guess they'd run out of taunts and had to get creative. But now they won't laugh at me anymore because I've created an entire army of me-plants! Look at these guys, huh?

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: With these Doofenplants, I will take over the Tri-State Area! I made them omnivorous because carnivorous just wasn't evil enough. I mean, "carnivorous"? What? They can't hurt plants? What's that all about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How did you...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, why did the gum only hit me? (gets out) Take this!

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, you are. Yes, you are. Who's a good plant?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Okay, I take it back. You're an abomination. Now, attack, my hench-plants! Attack!

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Ow! No, no, no, not me! Not me! No bites! No bites! Bad plants!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold on. Where's Dad?

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's still in the garage lookin' fer a wrench wit' an English accent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, whatever you do, do not come outside.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't play mind games with me, Candace. You're pretending to not do what I know you're actually doing won't not make me not come outside.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, that's what—Wait, was that a triple negative? So... So, no.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, are you still in here?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Right here, son. (straining) I did manage to find my first edition of Caveman Man, the world's first prehistoric comic book carved out of granite. Just having a little less luck finding my spanner.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (grabs Dad's wrist) C'mon, Dad! I can't wait to show you the progress we made!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Kids, this is miraculous! I love the book-evator and the book slide, and... Oh, my, is that a leather-bound first printing of Kafka's Metamorphosis?

Name: Buford
Dialog: A poor man's Edgar Allan Poe. Who added bugs to mask all the borrowed imagery.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I don't like reading. Bread Bowl Hot Tub!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (suspicious) Mm-hmm.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, your mother's got to see this. Back in a mo.

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh heh. Uh, I neglected to mention they've also developed a taste for wood, and paper, and Vanessa's pleather boots, and basically, anything I've put in front of their mouths.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaand it looks like we can add frying pans to that list.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We have to hit the self-destruct button!

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Save me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I'm not a plant. I—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I deserve that.

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant... (etc.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa! That's funky! Doze are da weirdest-lookin' plants I've ever seen!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do their faces look familiar?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, they don't look like anybody.

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I can't look! Just like the library at Alexandria! Whyyyyyy?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't be so dramatic, all these books are online.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could use this.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And this.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And these.

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It's survival!

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm eating, I'm a plant, I'm a plant plant plant...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (brandishing a sword) We won't let this bookcase go without a fight. (whacks a plant with the sword) Don't let them take the higher ground!

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant. I'm a plant.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now this is what I'm talkin' about!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When have you ever talked about this?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Tuesday. A week ago.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I wuz just thinkin', wouldn't it be cathartic ta pound a buncha carnivorous plants inta submission with a book?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have no recollection of that.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Less talky-talky, more fighty-fighty!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come out to the backyard and see what the boys have made, and I'll be your best friend! I'll only apply to local colleges. I'll put you in the nice senior care facility!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, Linda, you really should see what the boys have made. It's quite impressive.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? Oh, sure, when he says it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Doofenplants
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm a plant...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fall back! We are outnumbered!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and also my own hubris for creating an army of me-plants!

Name: Drusselstinian bullies
Dialog: You still ain't got no chlorophyll! You still ain't got no chlorophyll!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, why are you guys still wearing the same clothes?

Name: Drusselstinian bullies
Dialog: We did it for de callback! We did it for de call back!

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant. (explodes)

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant. (explodes)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, kids, that is impressive.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It is lovely, but it seemed bigger.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, (pulls her back into the house) I can't wait for you to have children of your own one day.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here you go, Dad. Your very own bookcase. Sorry we lost some of it. There was a bit of an incident.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, kids, it's wonderful. The big one wouldn't have fit in the library anyway. Oh, I found my spanner!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so weird.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It's survival!

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm eating, I'm a plant, I'm a plant plant plant...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (pants for a while)

Name: Doofenplant
Dialog: I'm a plant, I'm a plant, I'm eating, I'm a plant, I'm a plant plant plant...
